title: DesignState
description:
Design state (blueprint §3.3). Set only by the feasibility engine (packages/feasibility). The AI model, the API and the app never set or upgrade it.
- IDEA_ONLY: outside verified recipes or missing essential inputs. Explore or ask a tailor; no cut plan.
- NEEDS_INPUT: missing or contradictory dimensions, or an unclear source panel. Ask for measurements or corrections.
- FAILED_CHECKS: one or more hard constraints failed. Explain the failure and offer supported changes.
- PASS_SUPPORTED_CHECKS: the implemented measurement, material and rule gates passed. Preview, reviewed DIY plan or tailor brief after the final ruler checkpoint.
- SUPERSEDED: the revision was changed after passing checks. Read-only; the new revision must pass on its own.
